# Security policy

## Reporting a problem

If you find a security issue on www.enhancerworx.in or in this repository, please do not open a public issue.
Email enhancerworx@gmail.com with the details, or use GitHub's "Report a vulnerability" button on the Security tab.
We reply within 3 business days.

## Scope

This is a static website with no server, database or user accounts.
